exposure: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) in women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM)
Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) without Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
cohort: The study included 88 women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), aged 18 years and older with gestational age between 5 and 40 weeks, categorized by the presence or absence of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).
finding: The study found that patients with GDM and PCOS did not have poorer fetomaternal outcomes compared to those with GDM alone.
